linear map Q1 d0 →ₗ C2 induced by d1 given d1∘d0=0

relations.statement: A linear kappa on Q1 with kappa(mk h)=d1 h exists iff d1 ∘ d0 = 0
relations.hypotheses: d0: C0 →ₗ C1, d1: C1 →ₗ C2 over field K

relations.statement: With d1∘d0=0, ker kappa equals the image under the quotient map of ker d1

lemmas.statement: For a norm J2 on C2, Gamma(delta)=J2(d1 delta) is well defined on Q1 iff d1 d0 = 0; for a seminorm iff im(d1 d0) is contained in ker J2
Linear descent of d1 to Q1 is equivalent to d1∘d0=0

near_misses.claim: Gamma descends to Q1 when d1 d0 is nonzero but only small
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Comparing a repair d0 c with the zero representative gives J2(d1 d0 c)=0, so for a norm d1 d0 c=0 is forced; smallness is not enough

near_misses.claim: A zero K derives the degree-1 window from Genesis admission
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: BOTTLENECK states a zero K is only a typing certificate and does not derive the window (TFQ-0344)
